name: Gopeed
tagline: 高速开源下载器，支持 HTTP / BT / 磁力 / ed2k
taglineEn: Fast open-source downloader supporting HTTP, BT, magnet and ed2k
description: Gopeed 是一款开源免费的高速下载器，采用 Golang + Flutter 构建，支持 HTTP(S)、BitTorrent、磁力链、ed2k 等多种协议，跨平台、界面简洁、无广告无捆绑。
descriptionEn: Gopeed is a free, open-source, high-speed downloader built with Golang + Flutter. It supports HTTP(S), BitTorrent, magnet links, ed2k and more, is cross-platform, and has a clean ad-free, bundle-free interface.
author: GopeedLab
